purpose: Implement mobile-first purchase-request editor components with explicit adapter contract and honest pending/failure/reconciliation states; no API or production activation.
publication_policy: Parent sole publisher; new isolated worker checkout; independent code/privacy review and exact-head/base CI required.
sql_policy: No SQL, owner-DLL execution, customer data, credentials or runtime changes.
constraints: Four new worker files only; immutable admission unchanged; existing workspace/nav/BFF/API/source schemas remain unchanged
Purchase REQUEST model is distinct from AP_Order purchase order; never relabel existing order routes
Internal UI props are not a claimed HTTP/ERP command contract; final form/menu/permissions/save/submit transitions await verified source handoff
Use source-pinned purchase request metadata for represented fields and precision; decimal18,0 quantity/unitprice use exact strings, not unsafe JS floating point
Mobile accessible single-column header/line/review/actions with touch and keyboard; source-aligned labels and clear unsaved/server-confirmed draft/submitted distinction
Server-provided authorization and availability gate all edits/actions; fail closed without an admitted real adapter/capability
No fake saved/submitted success, mock fallback on API failure, invented business status/numbering, hidden data persistence or customer-data logs
Stable submission intent and explicit pending/rejected/conflict/unknown outcome states; never automatic retry with new key after lost ACK; retain user input safely in component memory
On logout/scope switch isolate/clear sensitive form state and prevent stale late responses from updating another session
Tests must exercise actual component/state behavior and adversarial user flows, not only source substring assertions; reuse I05 browser harness if available without duplicating repo paths
No endpoint/DI/FE route/production runtime activation, no new package/project/lockfile changes; wiring reserved for verified shared contract
Preserve B01/P01/I11 and every existing scope; new isolated checkout; independent review and exact-head/base CI before merge
